items.title: Roy Haynes — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Carl Schroeder was there. I had several different people.

ctx.x: But you were branching off. You were stretching. You were trying to – you were bringing a lot of contemporary sounds. You were surrounding yourself with younger musicians too.

Yeah. Well, George Adams was a little older. He went with Mingus later. Carl Schroeder was there. I had several different people. And I was hustling during then. I had a lot of different gigs. Got a record contract quick with Mainstream. They still got a lot of stuff back there. Some interesting stuff, too. You talk about – I don’t know if you want to call it crossover or – what’s the other word?
